propositions: Rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center because it lacks a DC-aware adapter separate from the Cloud adapter.
DC differs from Cloud on three axes: REST v2 with wiki/plain-text bodies vs v3+ADF; PAT bearer auth vs ACLI subprocess; name-based user identity vs accountId.
Multiple independent copies of field maps and sanitizers exist across adapters and config, creating drift risk (status map has three copies with divergent deleted-key handling).
A shared jira_family layer must consolidate duplicated logic without moving location-pinned modules or breaking the dynamic loader, using dependency inversion instead of relocation.

The DC backend requires https with optional allow_insecure override, certificate verification always ON, PAT env-only, and configurable resolved-status workflow names to avoid misclassifying DC issues.
